external_collaboration.evidence_quote: In Somalia, we partner with Youth Link to teach young people about good hygiene and the importance of drinking clean water to avoid disease. We also support the management of the Youth Link programmes, which helps to build both structure and accountability in the organisation.

We are a proud member of Alliance2015, a network of eight European charities that work together to fight poverty. We work together to deliver aid and we campaign together at an EU level. By joining forces, we are better equipped to tackle the challenges of our work and use our combined influence to shape opinion in Europe.

We partner with research and academic institutions such as Trinity College Dublin and the Institute for Development Studies to help us to test our programming and produce robust evidence of what works. This helps us build on our successes and scale up where appropriate.

The Zurich Climate Resilience Alliance, powered by the Z Zurich Foundation, focuses on enhancing resilience to climate hazards in both rural and urban communities. Concern will be supporting communities in Bangladesh, Kenya, Malawi, and Pakistan in their efforts to adapt to extreme heat and flooding.

network.coverage_note: Concern Worldwide is a humanitarian organisation rather than a traditional educational institution, so it does not have campuses or a standard Erasmus+ mobility programme. The partner list is derived from corporate and strategic partnerships mentioned in the text.
